title: Billion-Dollar Session: Saylor's Supply Squeeze

# ORACLE BRIEF: THE SQUEEZE

Saylor just vacuumed a billion dollars of Bitcoin supply off the market in a single trading session. That's not capital deployment—that's operationalized conviction at scale.

While that happens, the chart is screaming structure. Bitcoin tagged a parallel channel from COVID lows through the bear bottom and tariff shock. Three macro regimes. Same technical level held. The $70,000-$72,000 zone isn't empty air—it's a loading dock built on prior buyer conviction.
